scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.next/standalone')){ fs.cpSync('public', '.next/standalone/public', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.cpSync('.next/static', '.next/standalone/.next/static', {recursive: true, force: true}); for(const f of ['.env.production','.env.local','.env']){ if(fs.existsSync(f)){ fs.copyFileSync(f, '.next/standalone/'+f); } } console.log('Static assets synced to standalone.'); }"
